Based on the analysis of the image, we have four shapes to evaluate by folding the left side over the central line (reflecting them horizontally):

1.  **Top Row, Left Arrow:** The arrow points to the right. Its reflection would point to the left. The shape on the right side is also an arrow pointing to the left. **(Match)**
2.  **Top Row, Grey Triangle:** This triangle has its vertical edge on the left. Its reflection would have its vertical edge on the right. The shape on the right side is a triangle with its vertical edge on the right. **(Match)**
3.  **Bottom Row, Blue Circle:** Circles are symmetrical. Reflecting a circle across a central line simply places an identical circle on the other side. The shape on the right is also a circle. **(Match)**
4.  **Bottom Row, Red Triangle:** This triangle has a red hypotenuse sloping downwards from left to right. Its reflection would have a red hypotenuse sloping downwards from right to left. The shape on the right side has a red hypotenuse sloping downwards from left to right. Therefore, they do not match. (No Match)

Counting the matches, there are **3** shapes that will fit exactly on top of a shape on the right-hand side.

**3**
